attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The company enumerates nobody and the page gives it no number at all, only «το πλήθος»; by the settled rule a company the page does not name is one folder. The page gives no year and names no emperor, so no `dates` object, although the same day's neighbouring entries put the Arian persecution at Carthage in the reign of Zeno. No hymn is printed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (2 October 2026).
